approved_by: User approved these values in the plan of 2026-11-07 (primary budget, miss rule, mesh rule, contrast family).
purpose: Single held-out test of Paper 1: restart density + elite recombination (pair_plus_b35) against exact pair search, its components, ME-GA and single-flip search, on the free-space coupled NEC-2 RIS under full-runtime deadlines.
development_evidence: docs/ladder-v2-nol2-results-20261107.md, docs/ladder-v2-fixed-l2-results-20261107.md, docs/ladder-v2-combined-results-20261107.md (coupled_wire_dev_fine161 only). b35 was chosen after the no-L2 round on the same development data.
deviations_from_development_draft: matched_v2.development.json proposed the smallest budget with zero misses. On 3060-3 every budget, including 1 ms, had zero misses, so that rule would select 1 ms, where no component can act. The primary budget is instead 50 ms, the matched_v1 locked budget, chosen for reasons independent of the v2 results.

No numeric practical margin. Instead a contrast must exclude zero on both the 161- and 81-segment meshes, and the mean mesh shift is reported beside each gain. 241 segments is excluded because it falls below the NEC-2 extended thin-wire kernel validity ratio (docs/hybrid-audit-20261106.md).

held_out_test.fine_generation: scripts/generate_coupled_test.py --out data/processed/coupled_wire_test_v2_fine161 --fine-from data/processed/coupled_wire_test_v2 --fine-split test --segments 161; generated after this freeze, physics matrices only

run.node: 3060-3 (labkc-comm3), CPU 5 pinned, SMT sibling 11 logged; one process; single-thread numerical libraries
run.not_run: me_ga_paper (full population, no deadline) is not part of this test; it is reported only from development runs, if at all.

statistics.unit: trajectory (frames and seeds averaged within a trajectory); paired across methods
statistics.correction: Bonferroni over the contrast family within each budget
statistics.decision_rule: A contrast is supported only if its interval lies above zero on both the 161-segment rate and the 81-segment rescored rate, and neither method is excluded by the miss rule at that budget. The 50 ms results are confirmatory; 5, 10 and 100 ms are secondary and reported in full.
statistics.miss_rule: Every miss is reported. A method whose miss fraction at a budget exceeds 0.5% is excluded from that budget's contrasts. Misses cannot trigger a budget change or a rerun.

one_shot: The test is run once. A failure of the infrastructure (crash, node loss) may be resumed only from a fresh output with identical code and data, and is reported. No result can trigger retuning.
frozen_source_location: 3060-3 /mnt/home/faris/projects/atom-wise-ris-ladder-20261107 (run there); byte copies in outputs/frozen/matched_v2_src/. The local working tree has since diverged in pair_plus.py and network.py (Track 3 selector work).
known_baseline_behaviour: me_ga (published-spec reimplementation, random initial population, no all-OFF seed) scored 5.39 bit/s/Hz at 50 ms on development data, below the all-OFF state; me_ga_paper without deadline scored 9.67. b35-me_ga is therefore expected to be large and is reported as a comparison with a published-specification method, not as a contest between strong methods.
smoke_check: --smoke-dev on 2 development frames on 3060-3 CPU 5 before freezing: runner, 81-segment rescoring and all six methods ran; no test data read.
